title: promoteChange
responsibility: Validates a scoped Change against a clean configured source branch and every required lower target.

inputs.name: prepareChangeEnvironment.session
inputs.description: Project session whose requireProject().root is the source repository root that the environment checks run in; the configured source branch comes from deploymentConfig(root), not from this session.

inputs.name: prepareChangeEnvironment.request
inputs.description: Run mode and optional environment; only mode 'change' with an environment runs the branch, clean-worktree and target checks, and every environment changeEnvironment returns for it needs a configured deployment target. Any other request, including a change with no environment, resolves without checks.

inputs.name: promoteChange.context
inputs.description: Repository-locked run context for the change run, from which promoteChange reads root, emit, id, signal, session, revision.branch and request.environment. It runs inside the change run's existing repository lock, and no remote branches are pushed.

inputs.name: promoteChange.before
inputs.description: Baseline Map from repository-relative path to content hash (sha256 hex, or 'link:' plus the target for a symbolic link); files that are missing or neither regular files nor symbolic links are left out. promoteChange compares it with a fresh sourceSnapshot(root) through sourceChanges and stages only the paths sourceChanges reports.

outputs.name: prepareChangeEnvironment
outputs.description: Resolves with undefined when the request is not a change with an environment, or when the source branch, clean worktree and every required environment target pass; rejects with an Error for a branch other than config.sourceBranch, a dirty worktree or a missing target.

outputs.name: promoteChange
outputs.description: Resolves with a summary string: 'Code changes recorded. Verification is still required.' when the request has no environment, otherwise a line naming the last environment changeEnvironment returns (preprod for prod) and, for prod, a hint to use Deploy to promote preprod to production.
examples: Code changes recorded. Verification is still required.
Change verified and committed. Deployments through preprod are queued; follow the deployment activity indicator. Use Deploy to promote preprod to production.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: prepareChangeEnvironment throws for a branch other than config.sourceBranch, a dirty source worktree or an environment without a configured target, and promoteChange throws 'Change cancelled before deployment.' when context.signal is aborted before the verification command runs or after session.atBranch resolves. Errors from called helpers propagate unchanged, including changeEnvironment's 'Unknown deployment environment.' for an environment outside dev, stage, preprod and prod.
